description:
Rookie actor Lee Yu-myeong was cast in star director Park Jae-jin’s movie ‘Let Me Shine’. As a former swimmer, he had never achieved what he wanted on time in his life. After he gave up his dream of becoming a child actor, he took up swimming, and by the time he quit his career, he was an actor again. The same was true in his love life. Now that he has given up his unrequited love for Park Jae-jin, he can now roll around in the same bed with him. 

“You will definitely win a prize this time.” Moreover, the amazing Park Jae-jin is making a boastful speech with his eyes sparkling towards himself. 

(Souce: Lezhin, translated)
